AI integration

Local AI Chat & Business Reporting

A local Ollama model connected to explicit Laravel functions through structured command processing.

Context
Xeropex / 2025–2026
Technology
PHPLaravelOllamaSQL
Source
Private business code
My roleTechnical approachResultDemonstration & evidence

The problem

Business questions often require several steps: select a period, retrieve the relevant records, calculate results and present them clearly. A chat model alone cannot perform those application-specific operations or access an isolated database.

My role

I built the chat interface and the backend connection between the locally running model and the application's data and reporting functions at Xeropex.

Technical approach

I used prompts to ask the model for a structured text command. My own PHP/Laravel code extracted that command with regex and checks, then used programmed application functions to retrieve data and calculate results. The response could include report text, tables and charts. The model itself did not have direct database access.

Challenges & decisions

A language-model response cannot simply be treated as an application instruction. The integration needed to recognise the expected format and check the requested values before processing them. Different prompts and application functions handled different parts of the workflow; this was not model training or an autonomous agent system.

Result

The application connected natural-language questions to business reporting through backend functions. The central contribution was the integration: translating model output into data processing and a readable answer.

How the pieces connect

  1. User question
  2. Ollama → structured text
  3. Laravel parser & checks
  4. Programmed data function
  5. Calculated report / answer

Simplified conceptual workflow. Not an exact internal architecture.
